Established expertise in biomedical, molecular, and translational research, with experience in designing and conducting *in vitro* and *in vivo* experimental studies, managing and characterizing human biological samples, and working with 2D/3D cell cultures and animal models. item.title: Incarico di ricerca: Molecular mechanisms of nephroprotection by SGLT2 inhibitors: interaction between SIRT1 and hypoxia signaling in diabetic nephropathy (ROMA "La Sapienza")
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-11-07 23:59
Institution: ROMA "La Sapienza", Roma
Field: Medicine / 06/MEDS-08 Endocrinologia, nefrologia e scienze dell'alimentazione e del benessere

This project aims to investigate the molecular mechanisms underlying the nephroprotective effects of SGLT2 inhibition, with a focus on the role of the SIRT1/HIF-1α/HIF-2α signaling axis in diabetic nephropathy. The study will explore how empagliflozin (EMPA) modulates the balance between HIF-1α and HIF-2α through SIRT1 activation and how these pathways influence cellular adaptation to metabolic and hypoxic stress.

item.title: Incarico di ricerca: Development and refinement of innovative, multi-omic approaches to study the cellular and molecular mechanisms involved in pathophysiological and oncological processes (ROMA "La Sapienza")
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-11-06 23:59
Institution: ROMA "La Sapienza", Roma
Field: Medicine / 06/MEDS-02 Patologia generale e patologia clinica

The project focuses on developing and testing innovative, integrated multi-omic approaches and protocols aimed at investigating cellular and/or molecular biological and pathological mechanisms, as well as identifying diagnostic-prognostic biomarkers and therapeutic targets. Leveraging the platforms available at the Department of Experimental Medicine, the primary objective is the methodological optimization of cutting-edge technologies for application to the study of oncological, immune-mediated, or metabolic diseases.
